pepHrm015.replayRule: Authorized terminal replay creates a new linked receipt and new evidence; it is never an IngestionCommand mode and never rewrites the original receipt, run, item outcome or history.

idempotency.outcomes: Same tuple and same hash returns the original receipt without rerunning terminal work; same tuple and different hash returns 409; concurrent reservation has one winner.

database.terminalHistoryRule: Worker retry may resume the same nonterminal receipt by lease; terminal replay uses a new linked receipt/run/item lineage and cannot update original terminal outcomes.
